newsitem.title: UK: BAe to challenge GEC for Siemens defence arm-paper.
newsitem.headline: BAe to challenge GEC for Siemens defence arm-paper.

text.p: British Aerospace looks set to be the biggest challenger to General Electric Company in a likely bid to buy the defence arm of German industrial giant Siemens, The Sunday Times reported.
British Aerospace is an advocate of pan-European defence alliances and has unsuccessfully sought a merger with Daimler Benz for more than a year, the paper said.
GEC remains the favourite to win the bid, however, the paper said.

Siemens, whose defence business has annual sales of almost 600 million pounds ($962.4 million), is likely to swap the arm for GEC's 60 percent stake in telecommunications equipment company GPT, in which Siemens has the remaining 40 percent holding.
